title: Low-degree Fourier coefficient bound for DNF
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f$ be a sign-valued Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. Suppose $f$ has a DNF representation of width at most the positive integer $w$. For every nonnegative integer $k$, the sum of the absolute values of the Fourier coefficients of the real-valued version of $f$ over all coordinate subsets of size at most $k$ is at most $2(20w)^k$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$f$ has a DNF representation of width at most $w$
